investigation_notes: Reliability incident investigation of a production environment. Evidence consists of Elasticsearch aggregation results over application and proxy logs, Kubernetes, cloud-provider and host system events, Prometheus Alertmanager alerts, change-management / CI-CD audit records and metric anomaly detection. No root cause, impact or trigger is stated; these must be established from the supplied artifacts. Environment context: Organization: Tapwell Foods (food ordering); Platform: AWS us-west-2 (zones us-west-2a/2b/2c); VPC range: 10.55.0.0/16; Caching tier: self-managed Redis 7 on EC2 (maxmemory 12gb, allkeys-lru eviction) used by menu-api; Database: PostgreSQL menu database on EC2 (primary + replica); Services on EKS cluster tapwell-prod: web-bff, order-api, menu-api, loyalty-api; Change management: CHG- identifiers.
